analysis.title: US Equities Mid-Day Color
key_insights: Markets rebounded at midday, led by tech, as the AI trade showed signs of stabilizing after last week's degrossing episode. NDX +130bps and back above its 100DMA, R2K +81bps, SPX +67bps.
Breadth was weaker despite the index gains: 286 names down on the day and SPX ex AI -50bps.
The AI complex outperformed: neoclouds GSXUNEOC +585bps, optical GSXUOPTI +5%, inference chips GSXUINFR +466bps, memory GSTMTMEM +368bps, semis GSCBSMHX +3%.
The long software / short semis pair moved the 'right way', with GSPUSOSE -414bps.

The GS tech desk (TY Bartlett) cites three drivers of AI strength: easing of the 'AI financing concern' narrative after a successful META offering and an AVGO funding story overnight, anticipation of hyperscaler earnings and capex (GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN all report this week), and better overnight EPS (CLS +15%) with the trade bouncing off oversold conditions as high-velocity selling eased.
The momentum factor is recovering after a ~20% drawdown over the last few weeks. GSPRHIMO high beta momentum is +272bps and up ~8% over the last 3 sessions.
The GS PB team says global fundamental L/S momentum exposure is near YTD lows after the degrossing episode. The HF positioning pair GSTHVIPP is stabilizing at +110bps but is still down -10.5% MTD.
Market volumes are down 7%. ETFs are 27% of the tape, slightly below the YTD average. Top of book liquidity improved to $12.2m, up 25% from the 5DMA.

GS flows: the desk is 3 out of 10 across the floor, with a 1% sell skew. Long-only clients are better for sale, with supply in info comms services and macro products against demand in tech and consumer discretionary. Hedge funds are 10% better to buy on lighter notional, with demand in comms services, tech and financials against light supply in consumer discretionary and macro products.
The Chart of the Day shows fundamental L/S momentum exposure declined sharply in October MTD (GS PB).
earnings_insights: CLS reported better EPS overnight and the stock was +15% (basis not specified in the report).
GOOGL, MSFT and AMZN all report earnings this week, with capex expected to be a focus.
Greek banks (GSXEGRBK) report Q3 earnings on Oct 29 & 30 and Nov 5, per a GS note listed under 'More in Equity'. GS likes buying the dip.
risk_factors: Breadth is weak: 286 names are down and SPX ex AI is -50bps, so the rally rests on AI.
AI financing concerns drove last week's degrossing, and the rebound depends on the hyperscaler earnings and capex this week.
The HF positioning pair is still down -10.5% MTD, so the stabilization is early.
